description: Read your Sleeper fantasy football leagues. Post the week's scoreboard with every score and every starter, put up the standings, announce trades and waiver claims as they happen, check a lineup for injuries or an empty slot before kickoff, follow the playoff bracket to the final, look back over the draft, and watch the players the whole of Sleeper is picking up. Sleeper answers in IDs and codes; everything here comes back with people, teams and players named. Connect it with your Sleeper username and your leagues fill in the dropdowns. No account to create, no API key, and nothing that can change your league - it reads only.
